decisions.redesign_intent: Preserve the streaming-app metaphor while making it truthful, recruiter-first, distinctive, accessible, responsive, and performant
decisions.v1_scope: Complete recruiter-first v1 with static typed content; no CMS or recorded narration
decisions.architecture: React Router 7 Framework Mode with static prerendering; preserve URLs and client navigation
decisions.libraries: Motion 13 with LazyMotion and original Darshify icons
decisions.ui_architecture: Artist profile to proof tracks to conversion
decisions.test_coverage: 90% on new and modified code plus route, keyboard, accessibility, responsive, and critical-flow browser tests
decisions.release_strategy: Private preview validation followed by one atomic production cutover with a known rollback point
decisions.performance_contract: O(1) direct lookup, O(n) search/filter, O(n log n) explicit sorting, no global frame-by-frame state updates, interactions below 50ms
decisions.accessibility_target: WCAG 2.2 AA with automated axe and manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, contrast, touch-target, and reduced-motion verification
decisions.career_mix: Silent 60-second guided recruiter tour with progress, pause, previous, next, and evidence deep links
